quest.title: Wisdom of Ancient Civilizations
quest.description: It's been heard that Mondstadt's alchemy researcher Timaeus is trying to popularize the art.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Greetings! I am Timaeus, researcher of alchemy. Welcome to Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Alchemy is a craft that has been passed down since ancient times, but it is barely understood in the present.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Its mechanisms are magical and mysterious, completely unlike the principles that shape our understanding of the physical world.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: If we can get the hang of this, we should be able to create some pretty awesome stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This must be your alchemist's work bench?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: That's right. Why not give it a go yourself?

choices.text: I don't know, it sounds complicated...

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: You'll be fine, the procedure is actually very simple. If you're interested, I can show you the basics?

choices.text: I'm afraid I'll blow something up!

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: All we are really doing is following the methods of the ancients as best we can.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Much as one who uses a wind glider needs not understand how it was built in order to glide.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: The difference with alchemy is that every time I think I finally understand how it's supposed to work, something totally unexpected happens...

choices.text: What other uses does alchemy have?

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: To be honest with you, I just don't know.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: There's a lot of other mysterious recipes I have to research first.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Over the course of your adventures, you should come across some alchemists' notes from ancient civilizations.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: And as your Adventure Rank increases, more recipes will become available to you.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: You're welcome. I look forward to hearing more about your exploits!

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Well, see you next time. May the wind bring you good fortune on your path ahead.

choices.text: The next time you hear from me I'll be a Paimon-conjuring alchemy wizard.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why are you so obsessed with other Paimons? Do I no longer satisfy your Paimonial needs?

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Haha... You two are a fascinating pair I must say.

choices.text: Can you conjure up a new Paimon using alchemy?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! You shall have no other Paimon before this Paimon!

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Hahaha! Unfortunately my skills are not that advanced.
